Global dispersion **−200 to +200 ps/nm** is represented as `200.0` (upper bound from the pool). `host_interface_name` **SFP28** is the documented MSA form factor for all SKUs; **25GbE** appears under `standards_code` where applicable. No penalties were supplied. The alternate pool pair (`channel_total` 40, `frequency_min_thz` 192.1) matches the 192.10–196.00 THz (40ch) wording but conflicts with the 41-line ordering table including D9200 at 192.00 THz, so it was not used.
